decisions.label: OVERSTATED
decisions.rationale: T1 supports this tradeoff on Halvern-Faces, but the unqualified framing “for 256×256 face generation” generalizes beyond the package’s single dataset.

decisions.label: SUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: T1.r1 and T1.r2 show large reductions in every cost measure alongside FID increasing from 7.1 to 7.8; “modest” is a defensible descriptive characterization.
